label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Ryan Fox leads Open
items.text: Ryan Fox leads the 2026 Open Championship at Royal Birkdale by one shot over Cameron Young after birdieing four of his last six holes for a closing 68, earning his first major title.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy on PGA Tour
items.text: Rory McIlroy said the PGA Tour and FedEx Cup no longer excite him as before, admitting he might skip events since he only needs top 30 to qualify for the FedEx Cup final stage.

items.headline: Scottie Scheffler on Bryson Penalty
items.text: Scottie Scheffler called for stricter rules policing after Bryson DeChambeau’s two-shot penalty at The Open but stressed Bryson is not a cheater and likely did not act intentionally.
